card.name: Inside the word infection
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the piece of the word infect- (infection, infections, infected, infectious), mostly right after a split "In" or "Clin" in headings and journal names.

modes.label: Split infection words
modes.description: The stem of infection/infections/infected/infectious after a split start such as In or Inf, often in headings like Serious Infections.
modes.example: ) 5.1 Serious In<<fections>> LISRAYA increases the risk of infections

modes.label: Infectious disease journal titles
modes.description: The word Infect inside journal abbreviations such as Scand J Infect Dis or Clin Infect Dis in reference lists.
modes.example: Svensson E, Haaijer-Ruskamp FM, Lundborg CS. Self-medication with antibiotics in a Swedish general population. Scand J<< Infect>> Dis. 2004;
